import subprocess
import json
import os

print("Starting video build process...")

# Define project timeline and edit decision list (EDL) for JSON project file
project_data = {
    "title": "AI Technology",
    "target_duration": 120.0,
    "resolution": [1280, 720],
    "fps": 30,
    "video_codec": "h264",
    "audio_codec": "aac",
    "color_grading": {
        "contrast": 1.12,
        "brightness": 0.03,
        "saturation": 1.15,
        "sharpen": "5:5:0.8"
    },
    "timeline": [
        {
            "type": "title_card",
            "duration": 5.0,
            "title_text": "AI TECHNOLOGY",
            "subtitle_text": "Autonomous Systems & Robotics in Space & Exploration"
        },
        {
            "type": "clip",
            "source": "clips/ARC_20190417_AAV3189_AstrobeeLaunch_Shar.mp4",
            "start": 1.26,
            "duration": 22.0,
            "description": "NASA Astrobee Flying Robots Introduction"
        },
        {
            "type": "clip",
            "source": "clips/ARC_20210810_AAV3354_ISAAC_Astrobee_NASA.mp4",
            "start": 0.0,
            "duration": 25.0,
            "description": "ISAAC Autonomous Caretaking Demo"
        },
        {
            "type": "clip",
            "source": "clips/ARC_20230712_AAV3483_StarlingMission_Ove.mp4",
            "start": 0.9,
            "duration": 25.0,
            "description": "Starling Mission Swarm Satellites"
        },
        {
            "type": "clip",
            "source": "clips/JPL_20240508_EELSf_0002_Testing_Out_JPLs.mp4",
            "start": 5.0,
            "duration": 20.0,
            "description": "JPL EELS Snake Robot Testing"
        },
        {
            "type": "clip",
            "source": "clips/JPL_20241119_TECHf_0001_Underwater_Robot.mp4",
            "start": 24.0,
            "duration": 18.0,
            "description": "Underwater Robot Exploration"
        },
        {
            "type": "closing_card",
            "duration": 5.0,
            "title_text": "AI TECHNOLOGY",
            "subtitle_text": "Shaping the Future of Autonomous Exploration"
        }
    ]
}

with open("AI_Technology_project.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(project_data, f, indent=4)

print("Project file AI_Technology_project.json saved.")

import subprocess
import os

os.makedirs("build_tmp", exist_ok=True)

segments = [
    {
        "type": "title",
        "duration": 5.0,
        "text": "AI TECHNOLOGY",
        "sub": "Autonomous Systems & Robotics"
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "src": "clips/ARC_20190417_AAV3189_AstrobeeLaunch_Shar.mp4",
        "start": 1.26,
        "duration": 22.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "src": "clips/ARC_20210810_AAV3354_ISAAC_Astrobee_NASA.mp4",
        "start": 0.0,
        "duration": 25.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "src": "clips/ARC_20230712_AAV3483_StarlingMission_Ove.mp4",
        "start": 0.9,
        "duration": 25.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "src": "clips/JPL_20240508_EELSf_0002_Testing_Out_JPLs.mp4",
        "start": 5.0,
        "duration": 20.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "src": "clips/JPL_20241119_TECHf_0001_Underwater_Robot.mp4",
        "start": 24.0,
        "duration": 18.0
    },
    {
        "type": "closing",
        "duration": 5.0,
        "text": "AI TECHNOLOGY",
        "sub": "Shaping the Future of Exploration"
    }
]

vf_base = "scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1280:720:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,eq=contrast=1.12:brightness=0.03:saturation=1.15"

concat_list_content = ""

for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
    out_path = f"build_tmp/seg_{i:02d}.mp4"
    if seg["type"] == "title":
        # Generate title card
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"color=c=black:s=1280x720:r=30:d={seg['duration']}",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"anullsrc=r=44105:cl=stereo",
            "-vf", f"drawtext=text='{seg['text']}':fontcolor=white:fontsize=64:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2-30:enable='between(t,0,{seg['duration']})',drawtext=text='{seg['sub']}':fontcolor=#cccccc:fontsize=28:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2+40:enable='between(t,0,{seg['duration']})',fade=t=in:st=0:d=1,fade=t=out:st={seg['duration']-1}:d=1",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
            "-t", str(seg["duration"]),
            out_path
        ]
    elif seg["type"] == "closing":
        # Generate closing card
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"color=c=black:s=1280x720:r=30:d={seg['duration']}",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"anullsrc=r=44105:cl=stereo",
            "-vf", f"drawtext=text='{seg['text']}':fontcolor=white:fontsize=64:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2-30:enable='between(t,0,{seg['duration']})',drawtext=text='{seg['sub']}':fontcolor=#cccccc:fontsize=28:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2+40:enable='between(t,0,{seg['duration']})',fade=t=in:st=0:d=1,fade=t=out:st={seg['duration']-1}:d=1",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
            "-t", str(seg["duration"]),
            out_path
        ]
    else:
        # Process clip
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-ss", str(seg["start"]),
            "-i", seg["src"],
            "-t", str(seg["duration"]),
            "-vf", vf_base,
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
            "-af", "afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.5,afade=t=out:st=%f:d=0.5" % (seg["duration"] - 0.5),
            out_path
        ]
    print(f"Building segment {i}: {seg['type']}...")
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    concat_list_content += f"file 'build_tmp/seg_{i:02d}.mp4'\n"

with open("build_tmp/concat.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(concat_list_content)

print("Concatenating segments...")
concat_cmd = [
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0",
    "-i", "build_tmp/concat.txt",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
    "AI_Technology.mp4"
]
subprocess.run(concat_cmd, check=True)
print("AI_Technology.mp4 generated successfully!")
